attributes.name: Detect Evil
attributes.powers: During your turn, discard this card to examine the top card of your location deck. If it is a non-villain, non-henchman monster, you may immediately encounter it.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at a Divine 6 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.

corrections.corrected_text: On the spells Detect Evil and Detect Magic, change the first power to begin "During your turn." (Detect Evil also appears in the Character Add-On Deck.)
corrections.issue: Can I play Detect Evil or Detect Magic on somebody else's turn?
